provenance: public vendor self-report; API JSON read without credentials; not independently replayed on chain

supply.scope: operator's own indexed active endpoints; not unique suppliers, customers or whole x402 market

paid_verification.scope: operator scout purchase outcome; includes its own client errors, parameter refusals and unproven settlement; not a percentage of lost money

operator_reported_sales_usd.scope: cumulative reported settled product purchases, operator claims to exclude own wallets; not independently validated, no timeframe-aligned monthly revenue, unique buyers or profit

historical_failure_audit.cohort: 651 unsuccessful endpoint responses after signed payment authorization attached
historical_failure_audit.warning: 127/651 is a conditional audited failure cohort, not a representative failure rate or proof of unrecovered losses; non-settled responses must not be called paid failures

competitive_overlap: paid delivery probes and signed payer reports
supplier-paid verification and listing submission fees

licensing.paid_history: separately licensed; resale and republication of history as dataset or API excluded

decision: Do not treat post-payment delivery verification or paid demand intelligence as unoccupied. First demonstrate differentiated, independently verifiable outcome/recovery value and real buyer WTP; do not copy licensed history.
